patch.value: Migrate the output_format service override from the deprecated payload-echo protocol to declineServiceOverride

The override declines via declineServiceOverride() rather than by returning ctx.payload by reference; the host no longer emits extension_output_format_payload_echo_deprecated in a workspace with this package installed; pm output is unchanged and is not replaced by the host envelope

value.author: codex
value.text: The old protocol inferred claim-vs-decline from reference identity: returning ctx.payload unchanged declined, returning a copy claimed it (upstream 741). That made { ...payload } a workspace-wide outage — a claimed output_format payload replaces ALL printed output, so every pm command renders as global/format/options/result with the real payload buried under .result, which is the defect this package shipped in 2026.7.28 (upstream 794). The host now offers explicit declineServiceOverride() and handleServiceOverride(result), and emits extension_output_format_payload_echo_deprecated when it falls back to inferring from reference identity. Migrated to the explicit form and dropped the now-unused ServiceOverrideContext type import. Verified functionally, not just by unit test: reinstalled into a workspace holding all 17 published packages and confirmed the deprecation warning is gone from stderr while pm list --json still returns the real payload keys (items, count, filters) and not the host envelope.

value.note: output_format service override migrated to declineServiceOverride

value.author: codex
value.text: Scope correction on the close record, from CodeRabbit review on PR 53. The close_reason says pm output confirmed unchanged while the actual_result cited only pm list --json, which claimed more than it evidenced. Rather than narrow the claim, the evidence was widened: in the 17-package workspace, pm list --json, pm read <id> --json, pm stats --json, pm health --json, pm contracts --json and pm graph audit --json each return their own payload keys and none returns the host global/format/options/result envelope. The default TOON format was checked too — pm read <id> renders item/id/title as normal. The original close_reason and its history event are left intact; this note is the append-only correction.
